segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Chalo, Saturday raat wale checkout outage ka review karte hain. Blame nahi, bas seekhna hai.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Timeline main bata deta hoon. Raat 9:40 pe pehla alert aaya, error rate achanak upar gaya.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: 10:05 tak checkout poora down tha, payment page pe timeout aa raha tha.

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Aur 10:52 pe restore hua, matlab lagbhag ek ghanta kharab raha.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Root cause kya nikla?

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Database connection pool full ho gaya tha. Pool size 50 tha aur sale traffic mein requests atak gayi.

segments.speaker: Shreya Bose
segments.text: Sale ka traffic normal se teen guna tha, marketing ne push notification bhi bheja tha usi waqt.

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Aur Friday shaam ko ek deploy hua tha jisme naya report query thi, woh bhi connections pakad ke baithi thi.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Matlab do cheezein mil gayi, heavy query aur chhota pool.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Haan. Restart ke baad pool 120 kar diya tha temporary, tab se stable hai.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Toh usko permanent rakhte hain? Database us load ko jhel lega?

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Maine metrics dekhe, 120 pe CPU sattar percent ke neeche hai, safe hai.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Theek hai, decide karte hain, connection pool permanently 120 rahega.

segments.speaker: Shreya Bose
segments.text: Customers ka kya? Kitne logon ka paisa kata aur order nahi bana?

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Lagbhag teen sau chalis orders aise hain, payment success par order fail.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Shreya, un sab customers ko refund status ka mail bhejna hai, aaj hi.

segments.speaker: Shreya Bose
segments.text: Haan, main refund wala mail draft karke aaj bhej deti hoon, support ko bhi brief kar dungi.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Ab RCA document. Kunal, tumne timeline banayi hai toh RCA bhi tum likh do.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Haan, main RCA likh deta hoon. Kal subah tak doc share kar dunga.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Kal subah tak theek hai, management ko dopahar mein bhejna hai.

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Ek suggestion hai, poora database managed cloud pe migrate kar dete hain, scaling apne aap hogi.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Migration teen-chaar mahine ka project hai, aur cost bhi double hogi.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Haan Divya, migrate karne ka faisla is review mein nahi hoga. Woh idea abhi drop karte hain.

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Theek hai, bas option bataya.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Deploy wali baat pe aate hain. Friday shaam ka deploy hi problem ki jad tha.

segments.speaker: Shreya Bose
segments.text: Weekend pe on-call pe sirf ek banda hota hai, kuch toote toh sambhalna mushkil.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Toh rule bana dete hain, Friday chaar baje ke baad koi production deploy nahi.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Agreed, urgent hotfix ho toh lead ka approval lena padega.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Haan, final: Friday shaam koi deploy nahi, sirf approved hotfix.

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Pool usage pe alert bhi chahiye, assi percent pe warning aani chahiye thi.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Bilkul. Alert koi bhi set kar de, dashboard pe threshold daalna hai bas.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Main toh RCA mein busy hoon, mujhe mat dena.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Koi baat nahi, koi kar dega. Agle somvar tak pool ka alert lag jaana chahiye.

segments.speaker: Shreya Bose
segments.text: Aur load test 3 December ko plan hai, usme bhi pool ko test kar lena.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Haan, load test wala alag ticket hai, uski date wahi rahegi.

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Report query ko bhi optimise karna padega, abhi woh poori table scan karti hai.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Index daalne se kaafi fark padega, maine dekha hai.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Theek hai, woh backlog mein daal do, priority high.

segments.speaker: Shreya Bose
segments.text: Status page pe incident ka update bhi daal dein? Kuch customers ne social media pe likha tha.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Haan, ek chhota public note daal do, technical detail mat dena.

segments.speaker: Shreya Bose
segments.text: Theek hai, wahi refund mail ke saath kar dungi.

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Ek learning ye bhi hai ki pehla alert aane ke baad pachchis minute tak kisi ne acknowledge nahi kiya.

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Haan, on-call ka phone silent pe tha, sach bolun toh.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Escalation policy dekhni padegi, paanch minute mein ack nahi hua toh second person ko jaye.

segments.speaker: Divya Prasad
segments.text: Woh setting main dekh leti hoon, pehle se option hai tool mein.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Theek hai. Aur kuch?

segments.speaker: Kunal Thakur
segments.text: Nahi, mera ho gaya.

segments.speaker: Shreya Bose
segments.text: Mera bhi.

segments.speaker: Abhishek Rana
segments.text: Thanks sab, achha discussion tha. RCA aane ke baad ek baar aur milte hain.

decisions.fact: The database connection pool stays at 120 permanently.
No production deploys on Friday after 4 pm except approved hotfixes.

action_items.fact: Kunal writes the RCA document and shares it.
An alert on connection pool usage is set up; nobody named.
Shreya emails affected customers about their refund status today.

distractors.fact: Migrating the database to a managed cloud was suggested and dropped.
3 December is the planned load test, not the alert's due date.
